title: Type and justify every prerequisite
statement: Type every prerequisite link as hard or soft and as logical, evidence-based or conventional, let only hard, non-conventional links block a learner, and invent no chains the subject lacks.
detail: The course validator fails any graph link that carries no warrant, since every typed link must state why it holds (logical, empirical or conventional), and warns when a hard prerequisite rests only on convention, which cannot justify a hard instructional block without stronger evidence (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/handoffs/g3-reading-v2-feedback-2026-07-16/tooling/ti-courseplans-2169d1f/docs/standards/course-json/tools/course_validate.py`). The reading project's draft course graph keeps hard prerequisites for logical requirements, gives soft ones a fluency threshold instead of a yes or no, and keeps its comprehension band horizontal, with no fabricated prerequisite chains (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/skills/reading-science/applied/g3-course-graph.qmd`).
against: A conventional hard link draws only a warning, not a failure, and the course graph is a draft awaiting academic review (the same two files). It is listed as an open build item, not a check that runs yet (`ti-courseplans-audit/docs/instruction-modes-spec.md`). In mathematics prerequisite chains are deep and reliable (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/feedback/feedback3/WF - Assessment  Feedback Brain - 260624-200115.md`, line 368), so real chains do exist there; and the audit is listed as an open build item, not yet run (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/docs/instruction-modes-spec.md`, section 7).

The history edge was labelled a logical one, meaning intrinsic to the domain, when it is a conventional one, meaning a tested tradition. Passing one off as the other is the error that creates misconceptions costing more to remediate than the teaching saved.
a *conventional* edge (a tested tradition) passed off as *logical* (domain-intrinsic) is the exact error
Do not let a conventionally warranted prerequisite block progression until evidence upgrades its warrant.

`prerequisite_units` in the course map are **sequence prerequisites**: the immediately prior unit supplies chronology and vocabulary that the next unit may assume. They do not assert that history has one logically necessary graph.
